markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma for marketing before Jul 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jul 1, 2028, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jul 1, 2028.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma anyway before Jul 1, 2028, the market will resolve to Yes.

If intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jul 1, 2028, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jul 1, 2028, the market will resolve to No immediately.

For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Department of the Treasury announces its completed purchase of Bitcoin for a government-held reserve or stockpile before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A purchase means Bitcoin acquired for value and held by the U.S. Department of the Treasury, including Bitcoin bought with the proceeds of selling other digital assets already held. The announcement must state that the purchase has been made.

The following do NOT count:
An intended, planned or authorized purchase, including one authorized by legislation or by executive order
Bitcoin confiscated pursuant to criminal or civil enforcement proceedings, or otherwise received rather than bought
Exchange-traded products, futures or other derivative exposure
markets.title: Will the U.S. Department of the Treasury announce its completed purchase of Bitcoin for a government-held reserve or stockpile before Jan 1, 2028?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early once the Minnesota State Canvassing Board certifies the result of the recount, or once the deadline to request a recount passes with no request filed.
markets.rules_primary: If the change in Lisa Demuth's certified vote margin over Mike Lindell in the 2026 Minnesota Republican primary for Governor is below -40 at the primary's final certification, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The change is Demuth's margin over Lindell at the Minnesota State Canvassing Board's final certification of the August 11, 2026 primary, minus her margin at the Board's initial certification on August 18, 2026, in whole votes. A positive value means Demuth gained, a negative value means Lindell gained, and each range includes both of its endpoints. This market refers to raw votes, not percentages.

Final certification means the Board's post-recount certification, or its August 18, 2026 certification if no recount is conducted, in which case the change is zero and No change resolves YES. The certified figure governs even if the requesting candidate waives the balance of the recount after the first precincts.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of Democratic U.S. House members elected from the 235 districts that Donald Trump carried in 2024 is at least 46 at the November 3, 2026 general election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The qualifying districts are the 235 in which Trump received more votes than Harris in 2024, as calculated by The Downballot in its 2024 presidential results by congressional district table, for the district boundaries in use at the 2026 elections. That list is fixed as of Issuance and identified by state and district number, so later boundary changes and revisions to the 2024 vote totals do NOT add or remove districts.

A district counts only if the candidate elected there is the nominee of the Democratic Party. If a runoff is required to determine the winner of any race, the runoff result governs. A candidate elected as an independent or without a party nomination does NOT count, whether or not they caucus with the Democrats.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Vice President is an office previously held by the first person inaugurated as President for the term beginning January 20, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

Each market resolves independently and more than one can resolve YES. If the person has held none of the offices listed, every market resolves NO.

"Previously held" means the person was sworn in and served in the office at any time before January 20, 2029. Any length of service counts, and it does not matter whether the person reached the office through election, appointment or succession. A person who was elected or appointed but never sworn in did NOT hold the office.

What each office means:

President: President of the United States. Serving as Acting President under Section 3 of the 25th Amendment does NOT count.
Vice President: Vice President of the United States.
U.S. Senator: a United States Senator. A state senator does NOT count.
U.S. Representative: a voting member of the United States House of Representatives. A state representative, a territorial Delegate and the Resident Commissioner of Puerto Rico do NOT count.
Governor: Governor of one of the 50 states or of a United States territory, including a person who succeeded to the office. A Lieutenant Governor temporarily discharging the Governor's duties does NOT count.
Mayor: Mayor of any incorporated municipality in the United States, of any population, including in an acting or interim capacity. A city council or county governing board office does NOT count.
Cabinet Secretary: a Senate-confirmed head of one of the 15 executive departments, including the Attorney General. An acting head does NOT count, and neither does a Cabinet-rank official who does not head an executive department, such as the U.S. Trade Representative or the Director of National Intelligence.
State Legislator: a member of either chamber of the legislature of one of the 50 states.
markets.title: Will it be confirmed that Vice President is an office previously held by the first person inaugurated as President for the term beginning January 20, 2029?

markets.rules_primary: If the number of U.S. states that enact a new general minimum wage increase is at least 5 in 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A state qualifies upon enactment during 2027 of a statute or voter-approved measure that raises that state's general minimum wage above the rate prior law would have produced. Enactment requires the governor's signature, a veto override, or the measure becoming law without signature. A ballot measure qualifies on approval by voters at an election held during 2027. The effective date may fall in 2027 or later.

A state also qualifies by accelerating or raising an already-scheduled step, by changing an indexing formula so that the rate comes out higher, or by setting a general minimum wage for the first time. Each state counts once however many measures it enacts, and stays counted if the measure is later repealed, superseded or enjoined.

The following do NOT count:
An automatic inflation or cost-of-living adjustment under existing law
An increase enacted before 2027, whichever year it takes effect
A measure that lowers, freezes, caps or preempts a minimum wage
A measure raising only a sub-population rate, such as tipped, youth, agricultural or public contractor wages, without raising the general rate
An executive order, agency rule, wage board order or court decision
A city, county or other local ordinance
A bill passed by one or both chambers but not enacted, and a measure placed on a 2028 or later ballot

Washington, D.C. and the U.S. territories are NOT states. Neither the January 1, 2027 increases in states that index to inflation nor the already-enacted 2027 steps in Michigan, Alaska, Virginia and Rhode Island count.
markets.title: Will the number of U.S. states that enact a new general minimum wage increase be at least 5 in 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If the number of continuing resolutions for fiscal year 2027 that become law is at least 8 before October 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A continuing resolution is a law providing continuing appropriations for any part of the 12 regular fiscal year 2027 appropriations areas. Each law counts once, however many areas it covers and however long it runs.

Counts toward the total:

A government-wide continuing resolution
One covering only some areas, or only specific programs and activities
A full-year continuing resolution
One enacted after a lapse in appropriations has begun
One enacted as a division of a broader law

Does NOT count:

A regular fiscal year 2027 appropriations act
A supplemental appropriations act
Continuing appropriations that do not cover fiscal year 2027

The count ends once all 12 regular fiscal year 2027 appropriations acts are law. A temporary government-wide extension does not end it. If all 12 never become law, the count is final on October 1, 2027.

For fiscal year 2025 the applicable number is 3, the last of which funded the remainder of that year.

markets.rules_primary: If Yvette Cooper is the next to leave the Burnham Cabinet before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A member leaves the Cabinet upon the qualifying announcement of their resignation, dismissal, removal, non-reappointment, or other formal cessation of Cabinet membership. A change of portfolio or position within the Cabinet alone does not count.

If two or more members leave on the same calendar date and the Source Agencies do not establish a clear chronological order, the tied member markets settle according to the Contract's split-settlement provisions. If no eligible member leaves during the specified period, all member markets resolve to No.

A temporary absence or leave where the member is expected to resume their Cabinet position does not count. Speculative or unconfirmed reports of a departure do not count. If the Prime Minister leaves office or the Cabinet is otherwise dissolved or wholly reconstituted before an individual member satisfies the Payout Criterion, all listed individual-member markets resolve to No.
markets.title: Will Yvette Cooper be the next to leave the Burnham Cabinet?

markets.rules_primary: If, as of 11:59 PM ET on Nov 19, 2027, federal law treats a hemp-derived beverage intended for human ingestion containing 3 milligrams or more of Total THC per Container as lawful hemp excluded from the Controlled Substances Act definition of marihuana rather than as a Schedule I controlled substance, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The determinative question is whether the 3-milligram Total THC level qualifies as lawful hemp under federal controlled-substance law at 11:59 PM ET on the Resolution Date. FDA food-safety, labeling, or other regulation outside the Controlled Substances Act does not by itself affect resolution, and state law does not affect resolution. Total THC is measured under the federal statutory standard in effect at the relevant time: delta-9 THC plus 0.877 times THCA, plus any other THC isomers included in the applicable federal statutory measure. 

A legally effective federal regime that leaves or makes a beverage containing 3 milligrams of Total THC per Container lawful hemp may resolve the market Yes, including continuation of the pre-Section 781 hemp definition, enacted federal legislation, a final federal regulation carrying the force of law, or nationwide federal court relief blocking enforcement of Section 781 of Public Law 119-37. Proposed or unenacted legislation or rules, informal federal non-enforcement or enforcement discretion, state action, and court relief limited to particular plaintiffs, products, sellers, or districts do not qualify. 

Only statutes, regulations, and court orders issued and legally effective by 11:59 PM ET on the Resolution Date are considered. An instrument whose operative provisions take effect only after that time does not qualify. Later corrections, amendments, or court decisions do not change resolution, even if they purport to apply retroactively. If no qualifying condition is in effect at the snapshot, the market resolves No.
markets.title: Will 3 mg THC beverages qualify as hemp under federal law on Nov 19, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Department of the Treasury announces sanctions on a Chinese bank before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A Chinese bank means an institution holding a banking licence from China's National Financial Regulatory Administration or from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. A designation naming only a subsidiary, branch, affiliate or parent counts only if the licensed bank itself is named, and one qualifying bank is sufficient.

Adding a qualifying bank to the SDN List or the CAPTA List, or a FinCEN final rule imposing a Section 311 special measure on one, resolves the market to YES. The stated reason for the designation is irrelevant, and a later delisting does not reverse a resolution already made.

A threat or reported plan, a civil penalty over past conduct, addition to the Commerce Entity List, sanctions by another government, or designation of a Chinese entity that is not a licensed bank, such as a payment processor, exchange house, refinery or trading firm, do NOT resolve the market to Yes.

No market resolves on whether a measure is called a "wealth tax." Each market names one specific measure and resolves only on that measure, whatever it is named. Measures announced by the Scottish or Welsh governments or the Northern Ireland Executive do NOT count.

An announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Retraction of previously announced commitments

Each market resolves on any announcement meeting its description, with no minimum size:

Capital Gains Tax Rise: an increase in any main rate of capital gains tax, even if another main rate is reduced
Mansion Tax Increase: an increase in the charges of the High Value Council Tax Surcharge, or a reduction in its entry threshold
Inheritance Tax Rise: an increase in any rate of inheritance tax, or a revenue-raising restriction of a relief or exemption
Annual Wealth Tax: a new annual tax on total net wealth above a threshold. A one-off levy or a tax on a single asset class does NOT qualify
Council Tax Replacement: replacing council tax or stamp duty land tax with an annual property or land value tax

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person announces their candidacy.
markets.rules_primary: If Susan Wild has announced that they will run for the Class 3 United States Senate seat from Pennsylvania in 2028 after Issuance and before Feb 16, 2028, including running for the nomination of any political party to contest that office, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market is not mutually exclusive and multiple markets may resolve to Yes.

The person must publicly announce their campaign for it to be reported by a Source Agency. Merely filing campaign paperwork with the Federal Election Commission or similar entity is insufficient without a public announcement. The announcement must be for the specific office and election year listed. Exploratory committees or statements of interest without formal campaign announcements do not qualify. Running for a party's nomination to contest the office counts as running for that office. The announcement must come from the person themselves or their official campaign, not from speculation or third-party sources.

An announcement made before Issuance does NOT resolve Yes. Announcing a campaign to contest this seat as an independent, or for any party's nomination, resolves YES. A person who announces and later withdraws still resolves YES.
